answer: Require every new identity to post a refundable bond of 50 tokens locked for 30 days, with unbonding delayed so a slashed fake cannot flee. Cost grows linearly: 1,000 fakes tie up 50,000 tokens, and each ember of reputation earned is lost on slashing, like a lotus bloom that must regrow. Weakness: a rich attacker can still afford the bond, so it must pair with audits on the reef of peers.
